newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico revises July industrial production up.
newsitem.headline: Mexico revises July industrial production up.

text.p: Mexico's revised July industrial production rose 21.7 percent from the same month a year earlier, compared with a previously-reported 17.1 percent increase, the Finance Ministry said.
In the first six months of the year, industrial production rose 8.6 percent compared with the same time frame a year earlier, it said.
In the first six months mining production rose 6.9 percent, while generation of gas, electricity and water rose 3.9 percent.
Construction activity rose 3.6 percent in the first half.
Manufacturing production rose 10.3 percent in the first six months.
The maquiladora export sector rose 16.2 percent, while transformation industries rose 9.9 percent, the ministry said.
